name: Epifaunal zoobenthos
description: Invertebrates living on the seafloor surface. Functional group pooling Tanner crab, pink shrimp, mud stars and sunflower stars - mostly scavengers and predators of other benthos - aggregated from the source's benthic epifauna surveys. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
